lines.en: I follow the grass line along the hillside.

lines.zh: 白脉的翅膀一闪，我过了一道坡。
lines.en: A flick of my veined wings and I clear a slope.

lines.zh: 我飞得比别的蝶快，别眨眼。
lines.en: I'm quicker than other butterflies. Don't blink.

lines.zh: 风从坡下上来，我借它往上。
lines.en: Wind rises from below; I borrow it upward.
I skim the grass tips, fast.

lines.zh: 我绕着一丛滨菊收紧圈子。
lines.en: I tighten my circle around a daisy clump.
I fly, rest, then fly again.

lines.zh: 高处的空气薄，我扇得更用力。
lines.en: The air is thin up here; I beat harder.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头上方飞过。
lines.en: I pass over a stone.
I'm small, but not slow.

lines.zh: 风一变，我立刻改了方向。
lines.en: The wind shifted and I turned at once.

lines.zh: 我朝那片白花飞，那里有蜜。
lines.en: I make for those white flowers. There's nectar.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，避开高处的风。
lines.en: I fly low to dodge the wind above.
I circle the hilltop once.

lines.zh: 我在草叶上落了一下，又起来。
lines.en: I touch down on a blade and rise again.
The sun's going west and I'm still flying.
I settle on a daisy and feed slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀一开一合，晒着太阳。
lines.en: Wings opening and closing, I sun myself.
The hill wind is steady; I rest.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂抢了同一朵花。
lines.en: A bee took the same flower.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合起来，贴在花心。
lines.en: I close my wings and press to the flower's heart.

lines.zh: 草太高，我在里面看不见外面。
lines.en: The grass is tall; I can't see out.
I roll my eyes slowly toward the sky.

lines.zh: 一朵云把太阳挡住了，凉了些。
lines.en: A cloud covers the sun. Cooler now.

lines.zh: 我在花瓣上留下一点粉。
lines.en: I leave a little pollen on the petal.

lines.zh: 这里的花，今年开得很好。
lines.en: The flowers are good this year.

lines.zh: 我不动了，等风把我带走。
lines.en: I stay put and let the wind take me.

lines.zh: 一只蚱蜢跳过去，吓我一跳。
lines.en: A grasshopper jumps past and startles me.
You came up the hill. Breathing hard, I'd guess.

lines.zh: 我绕着你头顶飞了一圈。
lines.en: I circle above your head once.

lines.zh: 你手一抬，我顺着坡风升。
lines.en: Your hand lifts; I ride the slope wind up.

lines.zh: 我身上白脉，你看见了吗？
lines.en: See the white veins on my wings?
The wind's strong here. Are you steady?
Crouch down and I'll dare to land.
I land on your knee. Very lightly.

lines.zh: 这坡上的花，都是我常去的。
lines.en: I know every flower on this slope.
You're blocking the sun. A little chilly.
Don't grab. I'm faster than your hand.
My wingtip is crumpled.

lines.zh: 丘陵上的白脉，是我翅膀的花纹。
lines.en: The white veins on my wings are a hill-country pattern.
A short break in my white veins.
I land on the grass and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我飞得慢一点就是。
lines.en: With this wound I'll simply fly slower.
A patch of scales is gone. It stings.
I fly low to save strength.

lines.zh: 再碰一下，我就起不来了。
lines.en: One more and I won't get up.
The wind makes the wound ache more.
I hide deeper in the flowers.
That daisy is open.
White petals, yellow heart. My favorite.
I circled twice before settling.
This nectar tastes clean.
Standing by the flowerbed?

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，我吸完就走。
lines.en: A moment more; I'll finish and go.

lines.zh: 我翅膀扇得慢了，是放松了。
lines.en: My wings have slowed. I'm relaxing.
That one's bigger than this.
Let me try another.

lines.zh: 那朵滨菊正开，我过去了。
lines.en: That daisy is open. I'm going over.
You touched me and I shot upward.

lines.zh: 你擦到我的翅，白脉歪了。
lines.en: You graze my wing and its white veins skew.

lines.zh: 这一点风就够我偏一米。
lines.en: That little gust pushed me a meter off.
Your hat nearly caught me.
I land on your shoulder to steady myself.
I go around you and climb.
A little pollen lost. I can still fly.
Steady yourself; the wind pushed you.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，撞一下就晕。
lines.en: A body this small gets dizzy from a bump.
I'm fine. Just a crumpled wingtip.
We chase each other over the flowers.
Your white veins are clearer than mine.
Three circles, then come down.
The wind's strong. Let's keep low.
This flower has room for both of us.

lines.zh: 我的寿命不算长，别浪费。
lines.en: My life isn't long. Don't waste it.

lines.zh: 午后太阳最好，我们就那时。
lines.en: The afternoon sun is best. Then.

lines.zh: 你落下时，翅膀别合太快。
lines.en: When you land, don't fold too fast.

lines.zh: 跟着我，我知道哪片花多。
lines.en: Follow me. I know where the flowers are thick.
We still have time before dark.

lines.zh: 花瓣上有一滴蜜，我吸了。
lines.en: A drop of nectar on the petal. I take it.
This pollen will do for the trip back.

lines.zh: 我抱不住这么大的东西。
lines.en: I can't hold anything this big.

lines.zh: 这片花瓣落了，我停在上面。
lines.en: A petal fell; I settle on it.
There's sweetness in the scraps.
I try to carry it. I can't.
I push it into the flower's heart.
Those on the ground I leave.
This much is enough.
I land nearby and look a while.
A shadow moves below the slope.

lines.zh: 我往高处飞，那里看得远。
lines.en: I climb higher where I can see far.

lines.zh: 草动了一下，是风还是别的？
lines.en: The grass moved. Wind, or something else?
I see a net. The rim of one.
I stop on a flower and hold still.
You're coming up the slope, heavy-footed.
If I move, my white veins will catch the light.

lines.zh: 我数着你离我还有多远。
lines.en: I measure how far off you still are.
The wind helps me, and helps you too.

lines.zh: 坡下那团影子，我认出来了。
lines.en: That shadow below the slope — I know it now.
I skim the grass tips, going around you.

lines.zh: 你转身慢，我已经换了方向。
lines.en: You turn slowly; I've already changed course.
I climb and you lose me against the sky.
The flowerbed is easier to hide in.
A few steps left — I can count them.

lines.zh: 风把你的气味吹过来了。
lines.en: The wind brings your scent.

lines.zh: 我落在叶子背面，白脉朝里。
lines.en: I land on the leaf's underside, veins inward.
Your hand comes up, so up I go.
This stretch of grass will hide me.
A little longer and you'll leave.
Daisy nectar makes me fast.

lines.zh: 这点力气，你根本不会注意。
lines.en: With this little force you'd never notice.

lines.zh: 我扑向你的脸，虚晃一下。
lines.en: I dart at your face. Only a feint.

lines.zh: 鳞粉弄到你眼睛里，就算我赢。
lines.en: If my scales get in your eye, I count it a win.
I circle you until you're dizzy.
I don't bite. I've no teeth.
One brush and I'm off.

lines.zh: 追不上我，我比别的蝶快。
lines.en: You can't catch me. I'm faster than the rest.
I climb out of your reach.
Don't push me. Flying is all I do.
I come out of a cocoon on the slope.
The hill wind reaches me first.

lines.zh: 我翅膀干了，第一次扇动。
lines.en: My wings dry and beat for the first time.
The grass is short here and the view is long.

lines.zh: 白花一片，我认得那是滨菊。
lines.en: A spread of white. Daisies. I know them.
I take off, faster than I expected.
The sun on this slope is just right.
I settle on a petal.

lines.zh: 风把我抬起来，我顺势飞。
lines.en: The wind lifts me and I ride it.

lines.zh: 这片滨菊坡是新分给我的。
lines.en: This daisy slope has newly fallen to me.

lines.zh: 火苗一舔，我的翅膀就卷。
lines.en: A lick of flame and my wings curl.
I drop from high into the grass.
My white veins soak through and the wings sag.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹过了两个坡。
lines.en: The blast blows me over two slopes.
A hole in my wing, and I still must fly.
Magic froze my wings mid-air.
The flowers are spent; I can't find nectar.

lines.zh: 丘陵的白脉，只有一小片。
lines.en: Only a sliver of white on the hills.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，只有下落。
lines.en: No wind in the void. Only falling.
